FrenchWeb's 2024 headline tag reads [SERIE A], which is wrong: FrenchWeb itself wrote on 2025-11-20 'Elle avait précédemment levé 3,5 millions d’euros en pre seed', and the company calls its next round Seed. No source read names the lead of the 2024 round.

graduation.later_round: Seed (named as such, not a Series A)

ncodin.status_detail: Active; NCODIN SAS (SIREN 951105477, created 2023-03-28, Palaiseau) is 'A' (active) in the French company register search; partnership with CEA-Leti announced 2026-03.

valuation.basis: Seed of EUR 16M, no valuation stated.

ncodin.notes: CNRS (C2N) spin-out building photonic interposers with integrated nanolasers for chip-to-chip links in AI and HPC processors; chips, so Industrial & Robotics. Pre-Seed entry (EUR 3.5M, 2024-05, with Elaia and OVNI Capital), then a EUR 16M Seed led by MIG Capital (2025-11) in which Earlybird followed on. No Series A on record; the FrenchWeb '[SERIE A]' tag on the 2024 article is a mislabel. Press calls it Paris-based; the registered seat is Palaiseau (Paris-Saclay).
